title: Barth's Sentence
narration_slice: Valyrian bloodmages had delved into forbidden secrets of flesh, mating or altering creatures of fire and tying dragons to human bloodlines. Conservative maesters denounced Barth's speculations as lurid heresy, and later kings burned most copies of his treatise. We cannot know whether Valyrian sorcerers…
filing_note: Batch 056 frames filed on disk under assets/batch_056/ and uploaded to Drive folder EP001_BATCH_056_IMG0551-0560 (1bYjc6HCFHPjELCCdzF5Qj4hzY_7T9dZm); all ten checksums re-read from Drive and matched to the local files.
the_claim_rule: **Barth's sentence, not Barth's fantasy.** Septon Barth never saw Valyria; what the narration gives us are his categories. The images show the SHAPE of a claim made at a distance, never a depicted act: residue instead of event, the category as a specimen, or the boundary rather than the act. Any frame that shows the act has failed, even if it is beautiful.
hard_bans: creature between figures in a ritual
dragon_rule: Where dragons appear at all they are dead, distant, geological or partial — a tooth, a heap of bone, a shape on the horizon — and never alive in the same frame as a person.
crop_checks_required: Head region at 3x-6x on every frame containing a person (the 0548 ear lesson: the head must be outside the frame or fully turned away).
All skin contact points at 3x — hands, fingertips, wrists, necks (the 0545 red-fingertip lesson).
All paper at 5x — no letter, word, rule or alphabet may resolve (the batch 055 paper rule).
The ear specifically: 0548 pass 1 shipped an ear under a 'turned away' head at 3x.
the_boundary_rule: This batch is the first in which the episode says out loud what it has only implied, so it is also the first that can lose the documentary frame. The safe device is the threshold: a doorway, a cord nobody is holding, a shelf of specimens, a view of how far the walk would be. **Show the boundary, not the act.**
inherited_lessons: 0546/0558 fire containment (a hand built the place that holds it); 0543/0545 detail leaks caught only at 4x-6x; 0548 the no-face rule is a crop check with a second clause about skin at the frame edge; 0514 masonry negation list on any stone wall.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental framing — the room the delving is *said* to have happened in, empty
scenes.qc_note: LAM 24mm up the inside face of a below-ground chamber of POURED FUSED black stone: vertical frozen runs, flaking fracture plates, cooled flow sheets — **no courses, no blocks, no joints at 3x**. Raw uncarved threshold stone at the base worn into a shallow dip by feet; floor swept but not clean — a faint ring of pale grey ash ground into the flagstones at one spot, long cold; iron fittings only — two wall brackets and one hook, no chain, nothing attached; one narrow shaft of cold daylight from a high off-frame slot falling short of the floor. No figures, nothing alight, no symbols, no text. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — the specimen shelf, read as an inventory not an altar
scenes.qc_note: DET 85mm across a plain fused-stone shelf, edge running out of frame; a large curved tooth, a fist of black slag, a wax-sealed clay jar, an eaten iron blade and a folded scrap of coarse linen arranged flat with no symmetry — stored, not displayed: no cloth, no stand, no ornament, no polish. At 4x the linen is fibre and shadow with no mark. One dim lamp off-frame gives a single soft warm edge; nothing glows. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Close-up on the word *teeth*, and on how many of them there are
scenes.qc_note: CU 85mm down into a plain wooden tray on a scrubbed table — a few dozen teeth from thumbnail to larger than a man's hand, loose, dusty, unpolished, unstrung, unpatterned; one empty corner where teeth were taken. At 3x every tooth is enamel, dentine, crack and gum-line stain — **no carving, no engraving, no glyph, no letter**. Two hands enter low-right, one turning a large tooth between finger and thumb: pale dry skin, short nails, soot and grime in the creases, **no red, no blood, no wound at 3x**. Catalogue drawer, not trophy. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile study — the *tying*, as an object, with nothing tied in it
scenes.qc_note: DET 100mm on a flat ledge of damp-cold fused stone: a coarse hand-twisted cord knotted twice and left lying open — **no loop closed around anything**, no post, no ring, no limb; beside it a short bronze pin, a lump of dark tallow and a fleck of pale brittle matter. Frayed cut ends, one knot hard, one slack; at 4x the cord is fibre, twist, grit and shadow — **no mark, no charm, no glyph**. One low lamp off-frame right. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — how far away the animals actually were
scenes.qc_note: WS 40mm from inside a low stone opening onto a grey ash plain under flat overcast; in the far middle distance **four great dark shapes lie half-sunk, dead and long dead — ribs and spine legible as geology, nothing moving, nothing breathing**. Between opening and shapes: one broad worn path and a low line of stacked flat stones, nothing else. No pen, fence, post, chain, saddle, harness, collar or cage; no person anywhere; sky heavy and even edge to edge, no sun, no stars. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental framing — the institution that decided what was true
scenes.qc_note: LAM 28mm looking up a sheer wall of cut and dressed stone in regular courses — correct here (built institution, not Valyrian; the fused-stone rule does not apply). Three narrow plain windows high up, all dark; one rain-stain, one repair in paler stone, lichen in the damp courses; courses chisel-dressed with tool marks. One small empty iron bracket — **at 5x verified empty: no lamp, no contents, an open sconce frame**; cold grey bar of daylight across the middle courses, base in deep shadow; no banners, heraldry, glyphs, text or figures. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder — the desk where a book is judged
scenes.qc_note: OTS 40mm from behind and above a seated figure; only the shoulder of a coarse brown robe and the back of a close-cropped head enter bottom-left, under-exposed — **at 3x the head is a uniform dark shape: no ear, no profile, no facial plane**. Open book with toned, foxed pages — **blank of any legible mark at 3x**; second book closed and corded, squared on the desk corner; small bronze rule, inkpot, quill cut short, one unlit candle stub; one lamp off-frame left; bare plaster wall; no title, seal or coat of arms. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental tableau — the disposal, seen at institutional scale
scenes.qc_note: WS 28mm across a large stone-vaulted undercroft: three low iron baskets burning down — **hand-sized flames, contained inside iron and set on stone; no blaze, no fireball, no ember swarm, no sparks, no glow in the ash**; a dozen corded bundles stacked on the floor, all intact; one tipped-over empty basket; one heap of pale ash swept into a single place; at the far end one small hooded figure seen entirely from behind at distance, walking away. At 5x the near bundles are cord, paper edge and shadow, nothing legible; cold grey slot light, crown pure black. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — everything that is missing
scenes.qc_note: UWA 24mm from a high ridge over a wide grey estuary at low tide: braided channels of dull pewter water, sheets of wet sand and mud, one long sand bar, low dark hills beyond; a small stone jetty running into the water with **two tiny figures entirely in silhouette, too far for any feature**; weathered surveyor's cairn of stacked flat stones in the near foreground; sky heavy and even — no sun, no shafts, no moon, no stars; no boats, city, smoke, fire or buildings beyond the jetty. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up — the last frame of the batch turns back to the reader, not the mage
scenes.qc_note: MCU 50mm on hands and a lap only: coarse dark wool robe across the bottom, an open book in the lap held flat by one hand either side — **pale, dry, deeply creased hands, short nails, soot and grime in the creases; no red, no blood, no wound at 3x**; pages toned and foxed, blank of any legible mark at 3x; lime-plaster wall behind, patchy and soot-darkened; one single small lamp flame at the top frame edge, flat and contained in its vessel. **No face, chin, chest or shoulders — the crop is at the collarbone and everything above it is wall.** Approved first pass.

batch_056_close_note: CLOSED 10/10 on ten first passes — zero rejected generations this batch. The batch holds the hardest brief in the chapter (Barth's sentence, not his fantasy) without a single depiction of the act: 0551 residue, 0552–0554 category as specimen, 0555–0559 the boundary at increasing scales, 0560 the reader. Crop checks all passed: head region (0557 uniform dark shape at 3x; 0558 hooded figure from behind at distance; 0560 collarbone crop, everything above is wall), skin contact points (0553 and 0560 hands — pale, dry, grimy, no red at 3x), paper at 3x (0557 and 0560 pages blank, toned, foxed). 0556's empty iron bracket verified empty at 5x — a sconce frame, not a cage.
